subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should unconfigured memorySearch.sync.intervalMinutes change from 0 to a default periodic fallback such as 30 minutes, or should watcher-outage recovery stay opt-in and documented?
rationale: The source bug is real, but the proposed default changes existing-user background work and provider/indexing behavior, which repository policy treats as a compatibility-sensitive product choice.

options.title: Approve default-on fallback after repair
options.body: Accept the 30-minute default once the linked PR resolves conflicts and preserves an explicit intervalMinutes: 0 opt-out.

options.title: Keep periodic sync opt-in
options.body: Leave the default at 0 and improve docs or doctor guidance so users enable interval sync when watcher reliability matters.

options.title: Choose a narrower runtime health check
options.body: Avoid changing the default interval and instead ask for a watcher-health or warning path that does not add periodic indexing work by default.

recommendation.title: Approve default-on fallback after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the 30-minute default once the linked PR resolves conflicts and preserves an explicit intervalMinutes: 0 opt-out.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory config/docs history makes this the best available routing candidate for the default and user-facing documentation decision.
